PROCEDURE PORTS IS
V_RG_ID RECORDGROUP;

BEGIN

 -------------------------------------

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_VAL
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CHECK_VAL IS
 pl_id ParamList; 
 V_REPORT_FILE VARCHAR2(100); 
 V_COUNT NUMBER(7);
 RET NUMBER;
 DCLTN_REPS_PRINT NUMBER;
BEGIN
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
IF :START_DT IS NOT NULL OR :END_DT IS NOT NULL THEN
SELECT
COUNT(t2.port_cd)INTO V_COUNT
FROM

DCLTN_TYPES T7,
DCLTN_STATUS T6,
BRKR_MSTR T5,
IMPORTERS T4,
IMPORTERS T3,
DECLARATIONS T2,
INTL_MSR_UNITS T1,
DCLTN_ITEMS T0,
MEASURE_UNITS MU
WHERE
T2.PORT_CD=:port AND
(

 (
:P_DCLTN_TYPE = 0 AND T2.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2)AND 
 (T2.IMPR_NBR = :P_IMPR_NBR OR :P_IMPR_NBR IS NULL)
 )
 OR
 (
:P_DCLTN_TYPE = 1 AND T2.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (3,4,5,6) AND
 (T2.AGENT_NBR = :P_IMPR_NBR OR :P_IMPR_NBR IS NULL)
 )
) 
AND (
 (
 ((T2.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) AND :P_DCLTN_TYPE=0) OR :P_DCLTN_TYPE IS NULL)
 AND((T2.DCLTN_STA_CD NOT IN (9,11,12,14)AND :SELECT1=2 )OR(:SELECT1<>2) )
 )
 OR 
 (
 ((T2.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (3,4,5,6) AND :P_DCLTN_TYPE=1 )OR :P_DCLTN_TYPE IS NULL) 
 AND((T2.DCLTN_STA_CD NOT IN (5,9)AND :SELECT1=2 )OR(:SELECT1<>2) )
 )
 )


AND
(TO_CHAR(T2.DCLTN_DT,'RRRR-MM-MI')>=TO_CHAR(:START_DT,'RRRR-MM-MI') AND 
TO_CHAR(T2.DCLTN_DT,'RRRR-MM-MI')<=TO_CHAR(:END_DT,'RRRR-MM-MI') ) 
AND (T2.INSPTR_ID = :P_INSPTR_ID OR :P_INSPTR_ID IS NULL)
 AND 

--(T4.IMPR_NBR = :P_IMPR_NBR OR :P_IMPR_NBR IS NULL) AND 
--(T2.AGENT_NBR = :P_AGENT_NBR OR :P_AGENT_NBR IS NULL) AND 
(T5.LIC_TYPE = :P_LIC_TYPE OR :P_LIC_TYPE IS NULL) AND 
(T5.LIC_NBR = :P_LIC_NBR OR :P_LIC_NBR IS NULL) AND 
MU.MSR_UNIT(+) = T0.INV_MSR_UNIT AND
T0.INTL_MSR_UNIT = T1.INTL_MSR_UNIT(+) AND
T0.PORT_CD = T2.PORT_CD AND
T0.DCLTN_ISN = T2.DCLTN_ISN AND
T2.PORT_CD = T3.PORT_CD(+) AND
T2.AGENT_NBR = T3.IMPR_NBR(+) AND
T2.PORT_CD = T4.PORT_CD (+) AND
T2.IMPR_NBR = T4.IMPR_NBR (+) AND
T2.BRKR_PORT_CD = T5.PORT_CD (+) AND
T2.LIC_TYPE = T5.LIC_TYPE (+) AND
T2.LIC_NBR = T5.LIC_NBR (+) AND
T2.DCLTN_TYPE_CD = T6.DCLTN_TYPE_CD AND
T2.DCLTN_STA_CD = T6.DCLTN_STA_CD AND
T2.DCLTN_TYPE_CD = T7.TYPE_ID

AND
( ---------1
( ----+
:SELECT1 = 3 AND NVL(:PARAMETER.P_DEC_INS_REP_USR,0) = 1 AND
( ---------5
 
 ( ------2

PROCEDURE load_list IS
 /* 
 v_rg_id RECORDGROUP;
 F VARCHAR2(7);
 T VARCHAR2(11);
 BEGIN
 
 v_rg_id :=FIND_GROUP('DCLN_STA');
 if id_null(v_rg_id) then
 
 v_rg_id := create_GROUP_FROM_QUERY('DCLN_STA',
 'SELECT DISTINCT min( DCLTN_STA_DESC),TO_CHAR(DCLTN_STA_CD) 
 FROM DCLTN_STATUS
 WHERE (DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) AND :P_DCLTN_TYPE=0) OR 
 (DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (3,4,5,6) AND :P_DCLTN_TYPE=1) 
 group by DCLTN_STA_CD ORDER BY 2');
 
 END if;
 if populate_group(v_rg_id) = 0 then
 populate_list('P_DCLTN_STA',v_rg_id);
 
 
 END if;
 --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 
 END;
 */
 
 v_rg_id RECORDGROUP;
 F VARCHAR2(7);
 T VARCHAR2(11);
 V_DEC_INS_REP_USR VARCHAR2(100);
 
 
 tmp_str VARCHAR2(2000);
rg_id RecordGroup;
gc_id GroupColumn; 
the_Rowcount NUMBER;
sel_row NUMBER;
the_val VARCHAR2(20);


 BEGIN
 V_DEC_INS_REP_USR :=NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('DEC_INS_REP_USR',21),'0');
 
 --------
 
 v_rg_id :=FIND_GROUP('DCLN_STA');
 if id_null(v_rg_id) then
 
 v_rg_id := create_GROUP_FROM_QUERY('DCLN_STA',
 'SELECT DISTINCT DCLTN_STA_DESC,TO_CHAR(DCLTN_STA_CD) DCLTN_STA_CD
 FROM DCLTN_STATUS
 WHERE (
 DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) AND :P_DCLTN_TYPE=0 AND 
 ( 
 (DCLTN_STA_CD <> 6 AND :PARAMETER.P_JOB_ID NOT IN ('|| V_DEC_INS_REP_USR ||') )
 OR
 :PARAMETER.P_JOB_ID IN ('|| V_DEC_INS_REP_USR ||')
 )
 ) 
 OR 
 (
 DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (3,4,5,6) AND :P_DCLTN_TYPE=1 AND 
 ( 
 (DCLTN_STA_CD <> 8 AND :PARAMETER.P_JOB_ID NOT IN ('|| V_DEC_INS_REP_USR ||') )
 OR
 :PARAMETER.P_JOB_ID IN ('|| V_DEC_INS_REP_USR ||')
 )
 
 ) 
 ORDER BY 2');
 
 END if;
 if populate_group(v_rg_id) = 0 then
 populate_list('P_DCLTN_STA',v_rg_id);
 
--BEGIN
:PARAMETER.P_DEC_INS_REP_USR := 1 ;
 gc_id:=Find_Column('DCLN_STA'||'.'||'DCLTN_STA_CD'); 
 the_Rowcount := GET_GROUP_ROW_COUNT(v_rg_id);
 FOR j IN 1..the_Rowcount LOOP
 the_val := Get_Group_CHAR_Cell(gc_id, J);
 IF (the_val = 6 AND :P_DCLTN_TYPE = 0)OR (the_val = 8 AND :P_DCLTN_TYPE = 1) THEN 
 :PARAMETER.P_DEC_INS_REP_USR := 0 ;
 EXIT;
 
 END IF;
 
 END LOOP;
-- END; 

 END if;
 END;
